result.topic_en: Heavily corrected pencil draft of a letter to a journal editor, written on a printed form, about printing Riemann's treatises on Abelian functions, obtaining copies through the Dieterich bookshop in Göttingen, and corrections to the manuscript sent on 18 May.

methods.what: Vanishing of the line integral of X dx + Y dy around the boundary of a part of the surface T (Green/Cauchy-type integral theorem)

items.english: As is well known, the integral of (X dx + Y dy), taken over the entire boundary of a part of the surface T in the same direction throughout, is then = 0.
